purpose: 选择单个时间、时间范围，或用分段下拉组合时/分/AM-PM。

implementation.note: 共享基座在 assets/styles/gj-b2b-components.css。触发器与 segment 使用已发布 Disabled；Time-Item/group 因无 Disabled 轴才使用整项 50% 透明度。

auditedThisPass.note: 2026-09-09 用户确认 TMP-001：第 6 套是 Time-Picker-dropdown（原 TiTime 前缀已改），子图层 style=time|AM-PM，按母版计，不是 standalone。

componentSets.name: Time-Picker
componentSets.note: MCP metadata 将该集呈现为画板内 symbol，未返回 COMPONENT_SET 根类型。Size=small|medium|Large × status=Default|filled × Disabled=false|true。代表 variant：medium Default 3042:5437。

componentSets.name: Time-Picker-Range
componentSets.note: 独立母版，不是 Time-Picker 上的 Range 轴。Size × Status × disabled。代表 variant：Medium Default 3042:5341。

componentSets.name: Time-Picker/Time-Item
componentSets.note: status=default|hover|selected。64×28。selected 只改 Text/blue，无选中底。无 Disabled 轴；运行时不可选项 opacity 50%（TMP-004 关闭）。

componentSets.name: Time-Picker/item
componentSets.note: 分组触发段。status × AM-PM × Size。箭头 icf_Arrow_down。

componentSets.name: Time-Picker-group
componentSets.note: status × Size。12h 的 AM/PM 选择走 Time-Picker-dropdown style=AM-PM，不在 group 上另开关闭轴。无 Disabled 轴；运行时整组 opacity 50%（TMP-005 关闭）。

componentSets.name: Time-Picker-dropdown
componentSets.note: 第 6 套。style=time|AM-PM。专用面板，不是 Dropdown 实例。代表：time 3042:6299、AM-PM 4287:15404。AM/PM 项仍是 Time-Item。暂不补充秒列。

sharedStandalone.name: Input-Seperator/Picker-Separator
sharedStandalone.note: 与 DatePicker 共用；源拼写 Seperator。不属于 TimePicker 页独立组件计数。

timeItem.runtimeDisabled: opacity 50%; not a published Figma axis

behavior.range: End cannot be earlier than start; cross-day ranges show date or next-day context. Not a Figma variant.
behavior.panel: Dedicated Time-Picker-dropdown. style=time is two columns plus Medium Clear/OK. Its 140px source width is intrinsic content width; when anchored below a wider single trigger, the popup surface matches the trigger and centers the fixed-width columns. style=AM-PM remains 73×72 with two Time-Items and no footer.
behavior.hover: Trigger hover uses Border/focused. Not a published Figma variant.
behavior.disabled: Trigger and Time-Picker/item use their published Disabled variants. Only Time-Item and Time-Picker-group lack Disabled axes, so they use whole-component 50% opacity; do not stack opacity.
behavior.itemSelected: Selected Time-Item changes text to Text/blue only; no selected background.
behavior.itemDisabled: Unavailable Time-Item (including AM/PM items) uses 50% opacity. Not a published Figma variant.
behavior.groupPeriod: 12-hour AM/PM is Time-Picker-dropdown style=AM-PM. Do not add a hide-AM/PM axis on Time-Picker-group.
behavior.input: Typed values must synchronize with panel selection and validate format, range and step. Not a Figma variant.

constraints: Do not mix time formats within one page.
Do not add a seconds column; 2026-09-09 confirmed TMP-007 closed. style=time is hour+minute only.
Do not reuse Dropdown item height 32 for Time-Item 28.
Range is a separate component set, not a Range axis on Time-Picker.
Use 50% opacity only when Figma has no Disabled definition. Trigger and segment have published Disabled variants.
Trigger hover uses Border/focused; focus-visible/open still add the 2px BT_B10 ring.
Small trigger horizontal padding is 8; Medium/Large is 12.
Large trigger/range clock icon is 20; Small/Medium is 16.
Do not treat Hover/Focus/Open/Error as published Figma trigger variants; Hover/Disabled follow TMP-003 (closed).
12-hour AM/PM lives on Time-Picker-dropdown style=AM-PM; do not add a hide-AM/PM axis on Time-Picker-group.
Do not stack Time-Picker-group disabled opacity with segment disabled opacity.
When a time panel is directly anchored to a wider single trigger, use gj-time-panel-match-trigger: match the popup surface to the trigger, keep 64px columns centered, and do not stretch the columns.
Do not copy Figma negative margin on Large range segments.
